"November 7" Anniversaries - Minor Communistic demonstration

With the exception of the following minor incidents,
November 7, the 15th Anniversary of the Soviet October Revolution
and the 1st Anniversary of the Establishment of the Provisional
Central Government of the Soviet Republic of China, passed off
quietly:-
At 11.15 a.m., about 100 persons of the workers' and
students' type, appeared in isolated groups at tramcar and bus
stopping places at the junctions of Thibet, Peking, and Sinza
Roads. Shortly afterwards a member of the crowd at the corner
of Peking and Chefoo Road raised a Red Cloth Banner Bearing
the Soviet emblem and another set off fire-crackers, whereupon
the groups commenced to shout communist slogans. They were
immediately dispersed by a party of police who arrested 9 persons.
At 9.45 a.m., a small crowd collected on a piece of
waste ground on the north side of East Seward Road at Chaoufoeng
Road, shouting communist slogans and waving red cloth banners.
Another red Cloth banner was hung on an electric pole. The crowd,
however, dispersed upon the arrival of the police who succeeded
in arresting one of its number and seizing five red cloth banners.
No attempts were made to demonstrate in the French
Concession and the only incident recorded in Chinese territory
is the appearance at 2 p.m. at Tan Tsz Wah, Chapci, of some
forty persons of the worker class, evidently for the purpose of
demonstrating. They were, however, quickly dispersed by a party
of police.

Communist handbills comprising about 20 different kinds
bearing on the November 7 Anniversaries together with a few red
cloth banners were found in various parts of the Settlement throughout
the day. A bundle of communist literature of a similar nature was
also found on the floor of the Sincere Company Roof Garden, Nanking
Road.

“11月7日”周年纪念 - 小型共产主义示威

除以下小型事件外，11月7日，即苏联十月革命15周年暨中华苏维埃共和国临时中央政府成立1周年纪念日，平静度过：-
上午11时15分，约100名工人和学生模样的人，以分散的小组形式出现在西藏路、北京路和辛扎路（Sinza Roads）交汇处的电车和公交车停靠点。不久后，在北京路与芝罘路拐角处的人群中，一人举起一面印有苏联徽章的红布旗帜，另一人燃放鞭炮，随后各组开始高呼共产主义口号。他们立即被一队警察驱散，警察逮捕了9人。
上午9时45分，一小群人在兆丰路（Chaoufoeng Road）东熙华德路（East Seward Road）北侧的一块空地上聚集，高呼共产主义口号并挥舞红布旗帜。另一面红布旗帜悬挂在一根电线杆上。然而，警察到达后人群散去，警察成功逮捕了其中一人并缴获五面红布旗帜。
法租界内未发生试图示威的情况，在华界记录的唯一事件是下午2时，在闸北谭子湾（Tan Tsz Wah, Chapci），出现了约四十名工人阶级人员，显然是为了进行示威。然而，他们很快被一队警察驱散。

全天在租界各地发现了涉及11月7日周年纪念的共产主义传单，约有20种不同种类，以及少量红布旗帜。在南京路先施公司屋顶花园的地板上，也发现了一捆类似性质的共产主义文献。

November 7th Anniversaries - observance by local communists

In connection with the celebration of the November 7th
Anniversaries, it is reported that, between 6 p.m. and 9 p.m.
November 6, some 30 communist representatives from various districts
held a meeting in an unnumbered house at Shih Lai Sou (十间头),
Tseu Ka So (周家桥), Western Chapel, and passed the following
resolutions :-
1. That, irrespective of any precaution taken by the Settlement
authorities, the celebration of the November 7th Anniversaries,
be carried out, and that the activities be made as mobile as
possible in order to avoid coming into contact with the police.
2. That, xxxxx at 11 a.m. November 7, communists from various
districts meet at the junction of Peking and Thibet Roads
and then proceed either to the vicinity of the Great World
via Thibet Road or to the Shanghai North Station via Peking
and Chukiang Roads, according to circumstances, to hold
demonstration.
3. That, before proceeding to the appointed meeting place,
communists in various districts first gather at the following
places at 9 a.m. :-
Shanghai Eastern District : in front of the Labour
Hospital, Ferry Road near Funan Road.
Shanghai Central District : near Ngoh Hwa Teashop
(五芳楼), Boundary Road, near the Shanghai North
Station.
Shanghai Eastern District : Thorburn Road near
Yangtszepoo Road.

The demonstrations will include the surreptitious
dissemination of communist literature.

Communist handbills and banners bearing on the anniversary
of the October Revolution were found in the Eastern and Western
Districts on November 6.

At 9 p.m. November 6, two persons named Kiang King Tse
(江金之) and Yu Dah Chuen (俞大川) were arrested by the
D.4118/2 Municipal Police on the Sincere Roof Garden on a charge of being
in possession of communist literature with intent to distribute
same. The accused will appear before court on November 7.

11月7日周年纪念 - 当地共产主义者的纪念活动

据报道，为庆祝11月7日周年纪念，11月6日晚上6时至9时之间，来自各区的约30名共产主义代表在西摩路（Western Chapel）周家桥（Tseu Ka So）十间头（Shih Lai Sou）的一栋无门牌号的房屋内举行会议，并通过以下决议：-
1. 无论租界当局采取何种预防措施，都要进行11月7日周年纪念庆祝活动，并且活动要尽可能流动，以避免与警察接触。
2. 11月7日上午11时，各区共产主义者在北京路与西藏路交汇处集合，然后根据情况，经西藏路前往大世界附近，或经北京路和虬江路前往上海北站，举行示威。
3. 在前往指定集合地点之前，各区共产主义者于上午9时先在以下地点聚集：-
上海东区：弗纳路（Funan Road）附近的斐伦路（Ferry Road）劳工医院门前。
上海中区：五芳楼（Ngoh Hwa Teashop）附近，界路（Boundary Road），靠近上海北站。
上海东区：杨树浦路（Yangtszepoo Road）附近的韬朋路（Thorburn Road）。

示威活动包括秘密散发共产主义文献。

11月6日，在东区 and 西区发现了涉及十月革命周年纪念的共产主义传单和旗帜。

11月6日晚上9时，两名名为江金之（Kiang King Tse）和俞大川（Yu Dah Chuen）的人因持有意图散发的共产主义文献，在先施屋顶花园被 D.4118/2 市警察局逮捕。被告将于11月7日出庭。

November 7th Anniversaries - Plans of

According to literature which has recently
come into the hands of the Police, coupled with
information obtained from various sources, local
communists have decided to celebrate the November
7th Anniversaries by holding the usual "flying"
demonstrations and disseminating literature in
various parts of the Settlement and French Concession,
particularly the Eastern and Western Districts.

information obtained in this connection will be

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

Date 5th. Nov. 1932.

Subject (in full) Male Chinese named Woo Ah Kung brought to this station in
possession of one red banner.

Made by D1 S. Kennedy Forwarded by D.I. Thurgood.

Sir;

At 1.30.a.m. 5-11-32 P.S. 6 Wall and C.P.S. 897 brought to th
this station a male Chinese named Woo Ah Kung (吴阿根), unemployed/
coolie residing at 34 Yulin Road, whom they had arrested on Dalny
Road near Ward Road. When this person was searched one red banner
about 4 ft. long was found wrapped up in his pocket. This banner
was inscribed with large characters, a translation of which read
as follows: "Oppose the 'white' Terror" underneath written in
smaller characters was: "Chinese Revolutionary Mutual Aid Society".
The suspect stated that he had picked the banner from the roadway
near the junction of Pingliang and Dalny Roads. The undersigned
and C.D.Cl36 conducted a search at the man's home, where he has
been residing for the past six months, but nothing of an incrimi-
nating nature was found. He had been previously employed as coolie
at Ewo Cotton Mill Y'poo Road, but was discharged about three
months ago. D.I. Ross of the Special Branch was communicated with
and the facts of the case explained to him. As the inscription
on the banner is not of an anti-government nature, there is no
action taken against the person concerned, and enquiries failed
to ascertain proof that would substantiate a charge against him,
so he was accordingly released. Another smaller banner bearing
characters similar to the one first mentioned was later picked
up by P.S. Wall on Pingliang Road near Ward Road. Both banners
are forwarded to the Special Branch.

I am, Sir,
Your Obediently,
Kennedy.
D.S.

主题（全称） 一名名为吴阿根的华籍男子持有一面红旗被带至本警署。

由 D1 S. Kennedy 制作，由 D.I. Thurgood 转呈。

先生；

1932年11月5日凌晨1时30分，巡警 Wall 和第897号中国巡警将一名名为吴阿根（Woo Ah Kung）的华籍男子带至本警署，该男子为失业/苦力，居住在榆林路34号，他们在大连路靠近华德路处将其逮捕。搜查此人时，在其口袋中发现一面卷起的长约4英尺的红旗。该旗帜上写有大字，译文如下：“反对‘白色’恐怖”，下方用小字写着：“中国革命互济会”。嫌疑人称他是从平凉路与大连路交汇处附近的路面上捡到这面旗帜的。署名者和 C.D.Cl36 对该男子过去六个月居住的家进行了搜查，但未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。他此前曾在杨树浦路的怡和纱厂担任苦力，但约三个月前被解雇。已与特别支部的 Ross 督察联系，并向其说明了案情。由于旗帜上的文字不具有反政府性质，且调查未能找到足以支持对其指控的证据，因此未对该人采取行动，并将其释放。后来，巡警 Wall 在华德路附近的平凉路上又捡到一面较小的旗帜，上面的文字与第一面提到的相似。两面旗帜均转送特别支部。

此致，
敬礼，
Kennedy.

With reference to the attached file on the subject
of an anonymous letter received by the sub-manager of the N.W.K.
No. 1 and 2 Mills, No. 62 Robison Road, O.O.L., alleging that
communist elements among mill workers in Shanghai will start an
uprising on or before November 7, 1932, diligent inquiries have
failed to obtain confirmation of this report. The "uprising"
mentioned in the anonymous letter most probably refers to either
"demonstrations" or "flying meetings" which are to be expected
on November 7, which is the 15th anniversary of the Soviet
Revolution and the establishment of the Provisional Central
Government of the Soviet Republic of China in 1931. We have
no information at present concerning communist demonstrations
which may take place on November 7, and in this connection it is
reported that the local Communist Party has not yet discussed
how these anniversaries will be celebrated; but it is believed
that nothing serious will happen. As a result of a series of
raids carried out by the Municipal Police on the various branches
of the Western District Committee of the local Communist Party
which led to the arrest of certain of their leaders on the night
of October 11/12, 1932 (Vide I.R. 12.10.32), connections between
the local Communist Party and the Communist Headquarters known
as "Central" have been interrupted and in consequence caused the
temporary suspension of activities in the Western district.
In spite of this, the staff of Section 2 are keeping a sharp
lookout to ascertain the identities of the successors to the
arrested leaders, and in event of any information being obtained,
necessary action will be taken.
